offering_description.value: Provides local telephone, broadband internet, video and business communications services to residential and business customers in small-town communities in south-central Minnesota. Delivers services over its own fiber and copper network and also offers managed IT and hosted voice services.

primary_services.value: broadband internet; local telephone service; video/TV; managed IT and hosted voice; network transport

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential subscribers for internet, phone and TV; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, carriers and institutions

end_markets.value: residential telecommunications; small business; rural communities; carrier services

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly fees for broadband, voice and video; service fees: managed IT, hosted voice and carrier access charges

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates fiber and copper networks, selling to local consumers, businesses and carriers

geography_served.value: US regional: Southern Minnesota, including New Ulm area and surrounding communities, plus parts of Iowa

specialization.value: related lines: broadband, voice, video and managed IT services over shared network

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff and account managers for business customers; own locations: local retail and customer service offices; online: website ordering and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telecommunications carrier subject to FCC and state public utilities commission regulation and universal service rules

notes: Exact current footprint (including Iowa operations) and service mix are from memory and may be slightly off.
